subject: Request: HelixCo combined trial credits + discount (exec approval)
messages:
From: Soojin Lee <soojin@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 23 Nov 2026 09:14:00 -0800
Subject: HelixCo request: combined credits + discount for POC — need exec sign-off

Team,

Quick summary: HelixCo (Alicia Gomez) is asking for a 60‑day trial extension, $40k in free credits, and a 25% first‑year discount on the first committed tier if they sign within 60 days. They are currently mid‑POC, usage trending up (see attached snapshot), and legal/procurement say they can move quickly if we sign off on the economics.

Why this matters:
- High likelihood to expand to 3 product teams if POC succeeds (we've seen similar with SigmaHealth).
- Competitive pressure: they are also evaluating two other vendors.
- Revenue profile: expected $250–400k ARR in year 1 if we win.

Ask (one line): Exec approval to offer a one‑time combined package: 60‑day extension + $40k trial credits + 20% first‑year discount (with a 12‑month minimum commitment). If leadership wants to push to 25% we should require a 24‑month commit and >$350k ARR forecast.

Proposed guardrails:
- Credits expire at contract signature or after 90 days, whichever comes first.
- Credits applied only to inference usage, not support or add‑ons.
- Legal to confirm updated SOW and standard T&Cs (I attached the draft SOW).

Attachments: helixco_sow_v1.pdf (draft SOW), helixco_usage_snapshot_202611.csv (current usage).

I recommend approving 20% + $40k credits now to speed to signature; we can escalate to 25% for a longer commit if they push.

Thanks,
--
Soojin Lee
Enterprise AE, Redwood Inference
soojin@redwood.com | (415) 555‑0192

From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 23 Nov 2026 11:02:00 -0800
Subject: Re: HelixCo request: combined credits + discount for POC — need exec sign-off

On Mon, Nov 23, 2026 at 9:14 AM Soojin Lee <soojin@redwood.com> wrote:
> Team,
> 
> Quick summary: HelixCo (Alicia Gomez) is asking for a 60‑day trial extension, $40k in free credits, and a 25% first‑year discount on the first committed tier if they sign within 60 days.

Thanks for the concise brief, Soojin. I'm generally comfortable with the 20% + $40k structure given the expansion signals, but would like finance to confirm the impact to our blended ACV and margin if they convert at the lower band of forecast.

Two requests before I sign off formally:
1) Rishi — can you confirm whether 20% + $40k fits inside the delegated approval threshold?
2) Aditya — legal: can we get the SOW updated with the credit expiration language (credits do not carry past contract signature)?

If both confirm by EOD I will greenlight.

Marissa
Head of Sales, Redwood Inference
marissa@redwood.com

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 23 Nov 2026 13:45:00 -0800
Subject: Re: HelixCo request: combined credits + discount for POC — need exec sign-off

Marissa / team,

20% + $40k is within my approval delegation for strategic mid‑market deals IF we get a signed 12‑month commit with a minimum spend of $120k. We should make the first invoice non‑refundable to protect margin.

If the customer insists on 25% we need either: (A) 24‑month commit or (B) $350k minimum ARR guarantee. Without either, 25% is a no from finance.

I also confirm we can tag the credits to inference usage only; finance will report the credit usage in the onboarding chargeback.

Rishi
Head of Revenue Operations, Redwood Inference
rishi@redwood.com

From: Soojin Lee <soojin@redwood.com>
To: Alicia Gomez <agomez@helixco.com>
Cc: HelixCo Procurement <procure@helixco.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 24 Nov 2026 16:02:00 -0800
Subject: Approved: HelixCo — 60‑day extension + $40k credits + 20% first‑year discount (next steps)

Alicia — thanks for your patience. Good news: leadership has approved the combined package with the following terms:

- 60‑day trial extension (new end date: 2027‑02‑22)
- $40,000 in promotional credits, applied to inference usage only (credits expire at contract signature or 90 days after issue)
- 20% discount off list for first 12 months if HelixCo signs a 12‑month minimum commitment with $120k minimum spend

Required items to proceed:
1) HelixCo to confirm acceptance of the above in writing by EOD Friday, 2026‑11‑27.
2) Procurement to send PoN/PO once SOW is updated — Aditya will circulate revised SOW and DocuSign link.
3) Credits will be reflected on the initial billing schedule and flagged in finance reporting.

I've attached the draft SOW (helixco_sow_v1.pdf) and the usage snapshot. Aditya — looping you for the SOW update and DocuSign.

Alicia — happy to hop on a 20‑minute call with procurement tomorrow to walk through the timelines if helpful.

Best,
--
Soojin Lee
Enterprise AE, Redwood Inference
soojin@redwood.com | (415) 555‑0192

On Mon, Nov 23, 2026 at 11:02 AM Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com> wrote:
> If both confirm by EOD I will greenlight.
